Piacenza plain example datasets (four fields, 2019-2026)

Source: R/piacenza-data.R
piacenza.Rd

A small farm of the Po plain near Piacenza (Italy), used in the vignettes and in the SoftwareX article on agrinutri. The four fields were delineated from Sentinel-2; their crops were estimated from satellite data for every year from 2019 to 2026 (2026 provisional). The files are stored under inst/extdata and accessed with system.file():

Details

  • extdata/piacenza_farm.geojson: four fields (plots P01 to P04, 46.7 ha, EPSG:32632) with the crop class of each year (c2019 to c2026), field-mean soil from the regional maps (clay, sand in percent; olsen_value, Olsen P in mg/kg with olsen_unit = "P", and k_value, exchangeable K in mg/kg with k_unit = "K", ready for farm_balance(p_balance = TRUE, k_balance = TRUE)) and every input of farm_balance() for crop year 2024 (crop, ccp, expected_yield_tons_ha, prev_crop, Ntot in g/kg, SOM in percent, CN, rainfall from ERA5, no organic fertilisation).

  • extdata/piacenza_p01_rotation.csv: the yearly inputs of plot P01 from 2019 to 2026 (crop, crop-cycle class, previous crop, expected yield, October-January and February rainfall), to run the balance year by year.

  • extdata/sentinel-2/S2_piacenza_P01_20240813.tif: Sentinel-2 Level-2A surface reflectance over plot P01 on 13 August 2024 (10 bands, B02, B03, B04, B05, B06, B07, B08, B8A, B11, B12, 10 m; reflectance scaled by 10000, harmonised for processing baseline 04.00; pixels outside SCL classes 4-5 set to 0).

  • extdata/rer_soil_piacenza.tif: the regional soil maps 0-30 cm on their 100 m grid (EPSG:7791) over the farm and 1.5 km around it, one layer each for clay and sand (percent), corg (organic carbon, percent), ntot (total N, g/kg), olsen_p (mg/kg P) and k_exch (mg/kg K).

Sources

Soil maps: Regione Emilia-Romagna, Area Geologia, Suoli e Sismica, carte dei suoli della Regione Emilia-Romagna, strato 0-30 cm (tessitura, 2nd edition; dotazione in sostanza organica, 3rd edition; azoto totale, fosforo assimilabile, potassio scambiabile), released under CC BY 4.0. Sentinel-2: Copernicus Sentinel data 2024, processed by ESA, read from the Microsoft Planetary Computer. Rainfall: ERA5 (Hersbach et al., 2020). Yields: ISTAT, provincial statistics of Piacenza, or the reference yields of the guidelines where missing.

See also

farm_balance(), spatial_N_balance(), estimate_biophysical(), build_strip_prescription(), vignette("farm-and-prescription-map")

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
farm <- sf::st_read(system.file("extdata/piacenza_farm.geojson",
                                package = "agrinutri"), quiet = TRUE)
farm_balance(farm)[, c("plot", "crop", "N_target", "MAS_ok")]

soil <- terra::rast(system.file("extdata/rer_soil_piacenza.tif", package = "agrinutri"))
terra::plot(soil[["clay"]])
} # }
